description: Fetch one standard's complete specification record by id, acronym, filename, or RFC number. Returns { id, name, acronym, step, tier, lifecycle_status, phase, native_status, wire_archetype, governance, version, spec_url, discovery, adoption, summary_md, status_notice_md, superseded_by, probe_rule, has_template, last_verified, freshness, watch_count, last_change, evidence, url } (or unknown-id error with nearest matches). Use get for a known standard; use search to find unknown ids or define for glossary concepts.

id.description: standard id, acronym, filename, or RFC number (e.g. mcp, ard, llms.txt, RFC 9421)

name: get
